_readMeFirst: v0.13.0 Cloudflare activation is complete: the reviewed Streamarkr Worker is deployed, schema version 1 is applied to the dedicated D1 database, health/auth/schema were manually verified, and the PWA UI still intentionally uses IndexedDB/fake providers until the next focused migration.

targetArchitecture.status: Dedicated Streamarkr Worker/D1 backend is deployed and verified; frontend repository migration and live providers remain pending

pwa.cacheBoundary: same-origin unauthenticated app assets only; /api, cross-origin, and Authorization-bearing requests bypass Cache Storage

backendFoundation.canonicalTitleKey: ${media_type}-${tmdb_id}, enforced by D1 CHECK plus UNIQUE(media_type, tmdb_id)
backendFoundation.crosswalkUpsertRule: later partial provider payloads preserve already-known Trakt/IMDb/availability IDs when the incoming field is omitted
backendFoundation.canonicalMutationPrecondition: Library and rating writes require an existing canonical title and return a controlled conflict when it is missing
backendFoundation.auth: Bearer device token from Worker DEVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN secret; fail closed if unconfigured
backendFoundation.cors: exact APP_ORIGIN only; APP_ORIGIN intentionally not set until real PWA origin exists
backendFoundation.requestTracing: x-request-id on responses; sanitized structured server errors
backendFoundation.localWranglerConfig: wrangler.local.jsonc; local-only placeholder database ID plus preview ID
backendFoundation.localWranglerValidation: scripts/validate-wrangler-d1.mjs applies migrations with --local and verifies schema_version=1, 8 services, titles table, and d1_migrations table
backendFoundation.remoteWranglerConfig: committed account-neutral wrangler.jsonc plus ignored generated .wrangler/deploy config built from STREAMARKR_D1_DATABASE_ID
backendFoundation.remoteDeployPreflight: scripts/deploy-cloudflare.mjs independently resolves the literal D1 name streamarkr through Cloudflare and requires its authoritative UUID to match STREAMARKR_D1_DATABASE_ID, then verifies DEVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN exists before any remote D1 mutation
backendFoundation.remoteAutoProvisioning: explicitly disabled for D1 identity inspection, secret inspection, D1 migration and Worker deploy

deploymentPolicy.buildSecret: STREAMARKR_D1_DATABASE_ID stored only in Cloudflare Workers Builds
deploymentPolicy.buildToken: Workers Builds token with Worker deployment permissions plus D1 Edit, scoped to the Streamarkr account
deploymentPolicy.runtimeSecret: DEVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN stored only in Cloudflare Worker Variables & Secrets
deployOrder: independently resolve named remote D1 streamarkr and require UUID match
apply pending migrations to named remote D1 streamarkr

v0120.wranglerLocalD1: pass on exact final PR head with Wrangler 4.129.0

v0130.secretScan: no real D1 UUID, credential, personal data, generated .wrangler files, or BANDMARKR resource reference in executable deployment config

hardenedBehaviors: Caught Up requires no gaps through the engaged season while untouched newer seasons are ignored until started
On Hold and Watching Now use real watch timestamps, not manual correction changedAt
Finished series requires provider status Ended
season bulk overrides are bounded to currently known/released episodes
New Season supports future seasons before episode records exist
availability alerts are transition/cycle-aware
provider-owned availability reconciliation never touches user-owned stores
Search/Library membership rejects dangling title IDs
D1 Library and rating writes reject missing canonical title IDs as controlled conflicts
D1 canonical IDs are structurally tied to media type and TMDB ID
D1 provider upserts preserve known optional stable crosswalk IDs across later partial payloads
D1 availability represents multiple option types for one title/service
Worker personal routes fail closed without configured auth
unexpected Worker failures do not return raw internal error messages
service worker never app-shell caches personal API, cross-origin, or Authorization-bearing responses
D1 migration is validated in both Node SQLite and Wrangler local D1 before remote activation
remote config generation rejects missing/malformed/placeholder D1 IDs and never commits the real account identifier
remote deploy independently resolves the named Streamarkr D1 database and refuses mutation if its authoritative UUID differs from the configured build UUID
remote deploy refuses to migrate or deploy unless DEVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN is already configured
remote migration targets the named Streamarkr D1 database rather than relying only on a binding alias
remote Wrangler automatic provisioning is disabled
normal main merges cannot be the production deployment trigger
pendingIntegrations: Set APP_ORIGIN after the PWA hosting origin is known
Migrate frontend repository calls to Worker while retaining IndexedDB caching/offline behavior
physical Pixel 9 Pro Fold validation before V1 release
absoluteRules: No live provider calls from synthetic QA
No production deploy without explicit authorization
No real/personal data in fixtures or automated QA
Never overwrite user-owned data from provider refresh
Never cache personal API responses in the app-shell service-worker cache
Never commit API keys, OAuth secrets/tokens, Cloudflare credentials, real D1 UUIDs, personal data, or BANDMARKR data
Never reuse or modify BANDMARKR Cloudflare resources for Streamarkr
